notes.title: Twisted Toys – Free Demo Arrives August 13!
notes.content: [h3]Pack toys. Ship orders. Finish the shift… until the warehouse stops feeling empty.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45687503/bfbb2393cbf123b2f17bc09d7919cc17c9051a30.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]On [b]August 13[/b], you’ll get your first taste of [i]Twisted Toys[/i] with our free demo. Step into the shoes of a night-shift worker in a seemingly quiet toy warehouse. What begins as a simple, repetitive job soon turns into a disturbing psychological horror experience.[/p][p]In this 10–15 minute preview, you’ll explore the dimly lit aisles, learn the core mechanics of packing and shipping, and face your first chilling encounter with the unknown.[/p][p]The toys have been waiting. Will you make it through the night?[/p][p][/p][h2][b]📅 Demo Release Date:[/b] August 13, 2025 [/h2][p][/p][h3][b] Wishlist now:[/b] [/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839320/Twisted_Toys/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
